messages:
Sam (growth): Quick pulse  after the three launch posts + webinar drip the KPI board shows sessions up big but MQLs barely budged. Need a quick attribution sanity check before the weekly KPI review.
Nia: On it. My gut: lookback window + last-touch attribution are masking the webinars upstream impact. We pushed a longer nurture this time so MQLs may appear in later weeks.
Carlos (analytics): Agreed. Also saw two campaign naming collisions: launch_spring and launch_spring_a/b used the same utm_campaign in some spots. That will aggregate creative performance and hide which variant drove deeper funnel.
Sam (growth): Ugh. Can we reconcile sessions->registrations->MQL by landing_template and by attribution touch (first vs last)?
AnalyticsBot: Quick SQL snippet for reproducibility:
```
SELECT landing_template, attribution_model, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS sessions, SUM(is_registration::int) AS regs, SUM(is_mql::int) AS mqls
FROM marketing_events
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-07'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY sessions DESC;
```
Carlos (analytics): Ran a lightweight run: hero_full (last-touch) sessions +30%, regs +6%, mqls +1; webinar_landing shows regs->mql conversion 21% but low session volume. Attribution_model=first-touch shows a larger share credited to social posts.
Nia: So two drivers: volume from social posts (short-form) and higher-quality but lower-volume webinar traffic. Also check the attribution lookback window 14 vs 30 days; the KPI board uses 14 days which undercounts long-nurture flows.
Sam (growth): Action items: Carlos to produce reconciled CSV with columns [user_id, landing_template, first_touch, last_touch, reg_date, mql_date, utm_campaign] and add a note about lookback windows; Nia to compute median time-to-MQL by landing_template; OpsBot to add an annotation to the KPI board explaining the attribution model & lookback window. Aim for Monday 08:30 PT.
Carlos (analytics): Will post CSV and a short table. Early note: 18% of regs from short-form landings convert to MQL only after nurture triggers (median 13 days). Hero_full median = 3 days.
Nia: Also recommend we add a dashboard pill showing "attribution model" toggle (first/last/window) so reviewers can flip perspectives quickly. Small UX ask to product.
OpsBot: Annotation created on kpi-weekly: "2026-06-16 KPI note: dashboard uses last-touch, 14-day lookback by default. Webinar nurture extends median time-to-MQL; see reconciled CSV from analytics for fuller view."
Sam (growth): Great. Two quick cosmetic asks for the KPI narrative: 1) call out that session lift is concentrated in compact social templates (low immediate MQL rate), 2) highlight webinar regs as high-quality but longer-to-mature.
Carlos (analytics): CSV link: https://files.redwood.com/marketing/reconciled_4260012345.csv (posted). I'll attach a 1-slide summary with the median times and percent conversion by landing_template.
Nia: I'll draft the benchmark narrative paragraph for Monday and include the recommended dashboard toggles.
Sam (growth): Perfect. If we can get the CSV + slide by Monday 08:30 PT we'll slot it into the KPI deck. Closing this thread unless someone finds a blocker. :thumbsup:
Carlos (analytics): One last note  partner redirect traffic (partnerY) stripped utm_campaign in some clicks; I'm mapping referrer->utm heuristics in the reconciliation CSV.
OpsBot: Ticket created: MARK-998 - preserve utm params on partner redirects (assigned to infra).
Sam (growth): Thanks team. We'll include the reconciliation footnote in the KPI review so stakeholders have the full picture.
